description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/ix-text-ladder: no public read between steps (only the whole-file hash existed for the middle steps). Ascending key inserts into a unique Text index of long keys: IxT has 60 rows (ID 1..60, W 'k' + a four-digit number + 40 'p' characters) and unique index UX_IxT_W. Four statements add 20 rows each with higher keys. Asks at which statement the index leaf is split and where the new keys land; count and the index statistics are read back after each statement. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(ID), MAX(ID) FROM IxT
INSERT INTO IxT (ID, W) SELECT K + 60, 'k' & Format((K + 60) * 10, '0000') & 'pppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppp' FROM Nums WHERE K <= 20
SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(ID), MAX(ID) FROM IxT
INSERT INTO IxT (ID, W) SELECT K + 80, 'k' & Format((K + 80) * 10, '0000') & 'pppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppp' FROM Nums WHERE K <= 20
